name: Mirxes Holding Company Limited
summary: Mirxes Holding Company Limited is a Singapore-headquartered micro ribonucleic acid technology company, founded in 2014, offering diagnostic solutions to screen for cancer, cardiovascular, metabolic and infectious diseases in Singapore and China. Its products include GASTROClear, a 12-biomarker blood panel for gastric cancer, the LUNGClear lung cancer candidate and Fortitude COVID-19 test kits. It also researches and makes life science products.
